youtube.title: Why Train Seats Have Wild Patterns 🚆 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Public transport seat fabrics, called moquette, use busy, multicolored patterns because the pattern camouflages dirt, stains and wear. Operators clean seats far less often than the surface looks like it needs, and the dense wool or synthetic weave also resists wear from thousands of passengers.
